requirement: The system shall reject any attempt to record a clinical observation against a patient who has been discharged.
The system shall compute a patient's body mass index from the most recent recorded height and weight and flag it as underweight, normal, overweight or obese.
The clinician selects a patient from the ward list; the system loads the active medication list and displays any recorded allergies before prescribing.
The user opens the discharge workflow for a patient; the system checks that no active prescriptions remain and, if clear, marks the patient discharged and frees the bed.
As a nurse, I want to view a patient's vital signs trend over the last 24 hours so that I can spot deterioration early.
As a clinician, I want to record a new allergy for a patient so that future prescribing checks can warn about it.
Every access to a patient's record must be logged with the requesting user, the patient identifier and a timestamp for audit purposes.
The patient record table shall ensure a national health identifier is present, unique and never blank for any stored patient.
code:
-- core patient identity table
CREATE TABLE patient_record (
    patient_id           BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    national_health_id   VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL,
    given_name           VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    family_name          VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    date_of_birth        DATE         NOT NULL,
    admitted_at          TIMESTAMP,
    discharged_at        TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT nhi_not_blank    CHECK (length(trim(national_health_id)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT nhi_unique       UNIQUE (national_health_id),
    CONSTRAINT discharge_after_admit CHECK (
        discharged_at IS NULL OR admitted_at IS NULL OR discharged_at >= admitted_at
    )
);

CREATE INDEX patient_admitted_idx ON patient_record (admitted_at)
    WHERE discharged_at IS NULL;
hard_negatives:
-- clinical observations table
CREATE TABLE observation (
    observation_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id       BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    kind             VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL,
    value_numeric    NUMERIC(10,3),
    recorded_at      TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    recorded_by      VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT observation_patient_fk FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patient_record(patient_id)
);
-- bed allocation table
CREATE TABLE bed_allocation (
    allocation_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id      BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    ward_id         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    bed_code        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    allocated_at    TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    released_at     TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT bed_unique_while_active UNIQUE (bed_code, released_at)
);

requirement: Only clinicians assigned to the patient's current ward may view that patient's full clinical record.
The admission system shall assign the next free bed in the requested ward and refuse admission if no bed is available.
A patient's clinical record view page shall display demographic summary, current medications and recorded allergies, and shall hide fields the viewer is not authorised to see.
